factual_claims.claim: During the 2025 financial year, Tallink Grupp reported consolidated revenue of EUR 765.3 million, a decline from EUR 785.8 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Passenger volumes fell 0.9 percent to 5.53 million, and cargo transported dropped 19.2 percent to 245,004 units.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: These headwinds compressed annual EBITDA to EUR 130.1 million from EUR 175.2 million, while net profit contracted to EUR 17.3 million, or EUR 0.023 per share, against EUR 40.3 million previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Unaudited EBITDA totalled EUR 130.1 million (EUR 175.2 million in 2024)... unaudited net profit for the period was EUR 17.3 million (EUR 40.3 million in 2024)... EPS of EUR 0.023 (EUR 0.054 in 2024).

factual_claims.claim: The deterioration primarily reflected economic uncertainty in Finland, where subdued consumer confidence, inflation, and geopolitical tensions restrained leisure travel and commercial freight.

factual_claims.claim: Quarterly revenue advanced 2.4 percent to EUR 188.0 million, EBITDA rose to EUR 27.6 million, and net profit rebounded to EUR 12.2 million from a EUR 5.2 million loss.

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Financial prudence remained central to the period.
